import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # --- species: strip spaces and fix variants/typos ---
    if 'species' in df.columns:
        df['species'] = df['species'].astype('string').str.strip()
        # direct typo mapping (case-sensitive)
        typo_map = {
            'Adeile': 'Adelie',
            'Gentto': 'Gentoo',
            'Chinstarp': 'Chinstrap'
        }
        df['species'] = df['species'].replace(typo_map)
        # case-insensitive normalization to allowed values
        allowed_map = {'adelie': 'Adelie', 'gentoo': 'Gentoo', 'chinstrap': 'Chinstrap'}
        # map lowercased version
        lower = df['species'].str.lower()
        mask = lower.isin(allowed_map)
        df.loc[mask, 'species'] = lower[mask].map(allowed_map)
        # keep only allowed species
        df = df[df['species'].isin(['Adelie', 'Chinstrap', 'Gentoo'])]
    # --- body_mass_g: text numbers with commas -> numeric ---
    if 'body_mass_g' in df.columns:
        df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip()
        df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
        # enforce valid range 2500-6500 (set out-of-range to NaN, not needed for sum)
        df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    # --- flipper_length_mm: fix text numbers and negative/out-of-range ---
    if 'flipper_length_mm' in df.columns:
        df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'].astype(str).str.strip(), errors='coerce')
        # negative is data entry error: take absolute value (-200 -> 200)
        df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
        # optional: mark out-of-range as NaN (170-235)
        # df.loc[(df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    return df

def answer(df):
    # df is expected to be cleaned by clean()
    if df.empty:
        return {}
    # ensure body_mass_g numeric
    if df['body_mass_g'].dtype == object:
        df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False), errors='coerce')
    grouped = df.dropna(subset=['species']).groupby('species', dropna=True)['body_mass_g'].sum()
    # convert to int/float for JSON serialization
    result = {}
    for k, v in grouped.items():
        if pd.isna(k):
            continue
        # body mass sums are integers
        result[str(k)] = int(round(float(v))) if pd.notna(v) else 0
    return result
